title: Isihlalo Sobukhosi Esahamba Ngokuphazima Kweso
intro: Umuntu owayenegunya elikhulu wabusa phezu kombuso ocebile owawubusiswe ngengcebo engenakubalwa. Lapho kuvela inselele engalindelekile, lo mbusi wabhekana nokulingwa hhayi ngezinkemba kodwa ngokuhlakanipha nokholo. Okwenzeka kwakuzoholela ekuguqukeni okukhulu kwenhliziyo kusukela esicongweni samandla omhlaba.
clues: Ngabusa phezu kombuso obusiswe ngengcebo nokuchuma okungaphezu kokucatshangwa
Bengiyinkosi enamandla eyathola incwadi enesibindi efuna ukuzithoba
Izikhulu zami zangiluleka ngokuthi ngilwe noma ngenze ukuthula nale nkosi ekude.
Ngahamba nezipho ezinhle kakhulu ukuze ngihlangane nale nkosi ekude nami
Isihlalo sami sobukhosi salethwa ezweni elikude ngokuphazima kweso, ngaphambi kokuba ngibuye
Lapho ngingena esigodlweni esinephansi elibushelelezi njengengilazi, ekugcineni ngamemezela ukuzithoba kwami ​​​​ku-Allah

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
